name: jev-core
description: TypeSafe Jev (System One) as a decision primitive for Claude Code hooks. Ships the `jev` shell helper (one door to the API: named question sets, thresholds, cache, audit log, stub mode, fail-open contract) and two hooks that replace `claude -p` subprocess judgments in core-claude: jev-intent-gate (PreToolUse; the deps.* escalate rules, decided by two Nouls) and jev-research-nudge (Stop; hedged factual claims, one Noul). No SDK, no Python: POSIX sh + curl + jq.
